c.**What is epigenetics and how could it relate to your own research project?**
Epigenetics notes changes from parent species to their offspring via gene expression in the DNA sequence of an organism. Mmm, I do not focus of heritable changes, but I do look at gene expression, so in that capacity it relates to my own project because epigenetics does also focus on the modification of certain chemical groups within a genome; And that is where there is overlap with my project.

d.**Describe what a GFF file is?**
  .GFF is a Genome Feature File; which put simply is a file format in bioinformatics that is used to store information regarding the genome annotations in whatever sequences you might have .
